name: Qinglong(humanoid)
summary:
Qinglong is OpenLoong's public humanoid reference platform, developed to support a shared robotics research and engineering ecosystem. The project releases design information for the hardware together with control frameworks, whole-body dynamics software, technical documentation and data collected from the physical robot.

This combination lets developers study the system, reuse components and build their own experiments across simulation and hardware. OpenLoong also provides related datasets and the Gewu simulation platform for modeling, environment construction and data generation. Qinglong

description.en:
Qinglong is OpenLoong's public humanoid reference platform, developed to support a shared robotics research and engineering ecosystem. The project releases design information for the hardware together with control frameworks, whole-body dynamics software, technical documentation and data collected from the physical robot.

This combination lets developers study the system, reuse components and build their own experiments across simulation and hardware. OpenLoong also provides related datasets and the Gewu simulation platform for modeling, environment construction and data generation. Qinglong is therefore both a humanoid robot and a set of engineering resources for developing and evaluating embodied-intelligence applications.
